content_units: Recommended slot: 14:30–15:00 is free for all, but not long enough; the best full 90-minute option is 10:00–11:30 (Europe/Berlin) with one conflict.
There is   no 90-minute window between 09:00 and 17:30 that is fully free for all four people  .
The   least disruptive option   is   10:00–11:30  , which conflicts with only   Sofia for 10:30–11:30  .
Option   Time   Who is free   Conflict   Lunch impact   Notes
Best overall   10:00–11:30   3/4   Sofia (10:30–11:30)   None   Earliest strong option; avoids lunch; only 60 min overlap conflict for one person
Strong alternative   13:00–14:30   3/4   Ava (13:00–14:00)   Partial   Works after lunch start, but still touches lunch window and conflicts with Ava
Strong alternative   14:30–16:00   3/4   Malik (15:00–16:00), Daniel (15:30–16:00)   None   Later in day, but two people are partially impacted
Last-resort option   11:00–12:30   2/4   Sofia (11:00–11:30), Daniel (12:00–12:30)   Partial   Splits around noon; more disruption
Last-resort option   09:30–11:00   2/4   Ava (09:30–10:00), Daniel (09:30–10:30)   None   Too much early overlap
- It stays fully within the preferred work window.
- It happens early enough to leave time for follow-ups the same day.
- Only one person conflicts, which is good.
- But it starts immediately after noon and still sits close to the lunch-avoidance preference.
- Ava misses a full hour, which is a larger single-person disruption than a shorter partial overlap would be in some teams.
- But it creates   two attendee conflicts  , making alignment harder for a project review.
- The only fully open shared slot is   14:30–15:00  , but it is only   30 minutes  , not 90.
Option 1:   10:00–11:30     Best balance of attendance and timing     Only Sofia partially unavailable
Option 2:   13:00–14:30     Good backup if Sofia is essential earlier     Only Ava partially unavailable
Option 3:   Split format     14:30–15:00 live review + async pre-read     Zero conflict in live overlap
